description: This file defines the CustomerGroup controller class within the Opencart admin module. It contains methods that hook into customer group lifecycle events (add, edit, delete) to enqueue tasks related to customer group data processing, using the Opencart task model.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class managing event hooks for customer group actions in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Adds tasks to generate customer group data after a new customer group is added.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Adds tasks to update customer group data after a customer group is edited.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Adds tasks to handle customer group data after deletion.
